question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Count the Mach-O dylib load commands (LC_LOAD_DYLIB dependencies). Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: python3 -c "from macholib.MachO import MachO; [print(c[2].rstrip(b'\0').decode()) for h in MachO('pg_macho.bin').headers for c in h.commands if c[0].cmd in (0xc, 0x80000018, 0x8000001f, 0x20, 0x80000023)]" | wc -l
